objective: Test whether training-only estimated Witness Risk supports a frozen accept/abstain rule on calibration-unseen target identities.

roles.response: estimated_realized_mse; algebraically equal to full-effect MSE for this additive-residual construction
roles.decision: accept if risk <= frozen calibration threshold; otherwise abstain
roles.fallback: geometry-only prediction evaluated secondarily and never used to define the primary gate

calibration.purpose: freeze monotone mapping and thresholds only

test.eligibility: pair identity absent from every calibration row

threshold_rule: target-balanced weighted empirical quantile of calibration risk; no outcome-dependent threshold search
mapping_rule: increasing isotonic regression from calibration risk to calibration MSE, pair-balanced weights, clipping outside the calibration range
primary_metric: pair-balanced mean estimated_realized_mse among accepted queries

primary_pass_criteria.coverage_non_degenerate: pair-balanced test coverage at the 0.5 threshold is between 0.35 and 0.65 inclusive
primary_pass_criteria.cluster_uncertainty: pair-cluster bootstrap 95% upper bound for accepted/all MSE ratio < 1.0

secondary_support.risk_coverage_ordering: Spearman correlation between achieved coverage and selective MSE over 0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9,1.0 is >= 0.8
secondary_support.geometry_control: geometry risk is reported under its own calibration quantiles but cannot replace the primary score after reveal
secondary_support.fallback_policy: accepted estimated-Witness plus rejected geometry-only MSE is descriptive only

claim_boundary: Witness Risk is a self-risk for this construction, not a universal router.
The experiment concerns Norman pseudobulk targets, not cross-dataset calibration.
The formal rows existed previously; this is a newly frozen heldout reanalysis, not a prospective biological outcome experiment.
No official scPerturBench target is removed and no leaderboard is recomputed.
